name: evolver-status
description: Evolver health: the Proxy, engine setup, Hub sign-in, distillation candidate and drafts.

name: evolver-login
description: Sign in to the EvoMap Hub with a device code, setting Evolver up first when needed, and show the registered node.

name: evolver-search
description: Find the EvoMap strategy that best fits a task; where the agent sees the answer, its reuse is reported.

name: evolver-distill
description: Distill this session's latest verified turn into a draft Gene now, instead of at session end.

name: evolver-drafts
description: List distilled drafts; publish one to the EvoMap Hub for review, or discard it.

name: evolver-evolve
description: Run an evolution checkpoint: recall past outcomes, reflect on the current task, record the lesson.

name: evolver-sync
description: Sync assets between the local store and the EvoMap Hub (evolver sync).

name: evolver-review
description: Review Evolver's pending evolved changes, then approve or reject them (evolver review).

name: evolver-run
description: Run one Evolver self-evolution cycle on this repository (evolver run).

name: evolver-solidify
description: Solidify the working changes into a durable Gene or Capsule (evolver solidify).
